panels.description: Frosted Falcon hatch with a rotating machine challenge. Sitara reaches from the ice edge while Nayah catches her sleeve from above, holding the safety line. Leave upper third clear.
Sitara lowers her small silver TJ on the retrieval line toward the hatch maintenance plate. The sealed challenge-response module is visible. Leave top clear for interface lettering.
The TJ's green-black display reproduces the bars and dots as its red Antarctic booties steady against metal. The hatch indicator changes red to amber. Leave upper-right and lower-left clear.

The hatch opens only a handspan, showing black cable, a yellow maintenance lamp, and the edge of a directional drilling map. Sitara looks down; Nayah remains above with the route line. Leave upper corners clear.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: Nobody opens an unknown door from a hole in the ice.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Then we learn what it asks.
